title: vEDH Deck-to-Game Activation PRD
summary: Guest-first quick-start funnel letting players import decks and create or join vEDH Commander games without registering, with activation metrics.
notes: Self-declared PRD in title and filename; dominant signals are personas, user stories A1-A7 with acceptance criteria, success metrics, and non-goals. Contains a substantial 'Technical Specifications' section (GraphQL contract, service design, security) that carries SPEC-like content, but it is subordinate to the requirements framing. Status is 'Draft for implementation' — not an ADR, not locked. Sibling tickets doc listed in cross_refs per orchestrator context. Filename 2026- date prefix matched a numbered-ADR regex; that is a regex artifact and was disregarded.
